title: Database Sharding Simulation
description: Simulate database sharding with two in-memory stores, hash-based user routing, per-shard CRUD operations, and shard status monitoring.

steps.title: Shard stores and health check
steps.description: Create two in-memory shard stores (Map/object-based), each identified by index 0 and 1. Expose GET /health returning 200 with shard count.
hints: Each shard holds its own data partition

steps.title: Create user routed to shard
steps.description: Implement POST /users that accepts { name, email }, hashes the id to determine which shard stores it, and returns 201 with the user data including shard info.
hints: Generate a numeric id for each user
Hash the id to select shard 0 or 1

steps.title: Get user from correct shard
steps.description: Implement GET /users/:id that hashes the id to find the correct shard and returns the user data. Return 404 if not found on the expected shard.
hints: Use the same hash function to route the GET request
Look up the user in the determined shard

steps.title: Shard status endpoint
steps.description: Implement GET /shards/status that returns per-shard details including the count of users stored on each shard.
hints: Count entries in each shard map
Return array with shard index and count
Format: [{ shard: 0, count: N }, { shard: 1, count: M }]
